stem: During the 1830s public servants and officials were widely perceived to be unqualified. What practice reinforced that perception?

options.label: A
options.text: The public voting for candidates based on religious affiliations

options.label: B
options.text: The president rewarding political supporters with appointments to desirable positions

options.label: C
options.text: The federal government recruiting volunteers to serve abroad as ambassadors

options.label: D
options.text: Legislators awarding government contracts to the lowest bidders
